resources.string: Counts, and if you set limits, blocks the Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts you watch.

Reel Analyser reads the Reels and Shorts screens to count what you watch and for how long, and, if you turn on the Reel blocker, to open a block screen over them past your limit. In a browser it reads only the address bar. Everything stays on your phone. It never taps, types or scrolls for you.
